label: 2D Hand-Painted
h3_block: A hand-painted 2D cartoon staged like live-action drama. Clean, confident contour lines around every character; soft cel shading with two or three painted tones per surface; visible brush texture on skin, clothing and sets. Backgrounds are painterly and in the same brush family as the characters, with soft atmospheric depth built from layered painted planes rather than a photographic lens. Light is painted, never rendered: a warm golden key with a soft teal fill and readable painted shadow shapes. Lifted shadows, warm rolled highlights and stable midtones. {palette} Fine canvas grain, crisp line edges, no photographic grain, no lens blur, no 3D render shading and no photoreal skin. Character proportions follow the model sheet in every frame, and line weight never drifts. Animation is smooth and full, with clear arcs, overlapping action on hair and clothing, and readable silhouettes at phone width.
palette_default: Palette: warm amber, deep teal, soft cream and a coral accent.
